rules.name: General
rules.description:
As long as General is on the battlefield, his army may use the army special rule and add General’s LD during Initiative Tests.




If a General is attached to a friendly unit, that unit gets +6 attacks when attacking the enemy. A General allows all friendly units within 10 cm to re-roll the Cold Blood Test.




Issuing orders:
At any point during the Heroes actions, a General may issue an order to a friendly unit. The chosen unit must be within 30 cm from the General, but it doesn’t have to be visible. Roll a D6. A score of 4 or less means a successful order. The unit that was issued an order by the General can immediately perform any action as if it has just been activated. The General has three attempts to issue an order during the entire battle and may attempt to issue only one order per cycle.

rules.name: Command Group
rules.description:
If a Command Group is attached to a friendly unit, that unit gets +1 attack when attacking the enemy. Each friendly unit within 5 cm of a Command Group may use the following rules:
* After declaring a charge, the unit can (even despite the difficulties or obstacles) roll 3D6 for the charge instead of the roll that it could normally make, and choose the two highest dice rolls to make the charge.
* The unit can make a special sideways or backwards move up to 10 cm + D6 instead of its standard move or charge.
* Panic Tests of the unit that is not a Horde are successful on a score of 3 or less.

rules.name: Champion
rules.description: If a Champion is attached to a friendly unit, that unit gets +4 attacks when attacking the enemy.

rules.name: Mage
rules.description: If a Mage is attached to a friendly unit, that unit gets +1 attack when attacking the enemy. Each Mage gives a friendly army an additional prayer in the cycle. Mages have access to magic spells and items which they can buy before the battle.

rules.name: Legendary Hero
rules.description:
Extraordinary heroes with their own unique rules. They can be fielded in an army according to their description and requirements.


Legendary Heroes cannot repeat in an army, and if both players want to deploy the same Legendary Hero, they must roll a D6. A lower score is allowed to deploy the given hero, while the opponent must spend his remaining points otherwise.

rules.name: Competitive play
rules.description:
Each player’s army must contain:
– at least 40 bases for 750 army points
– at least 50 bases for 1000 army points
– at least 60 bases for 1250 army points
– at least 70 bases for 1500 army points

sharedRules.name: Fearless
sharedRules.description: This unit always passes a Cold Blood Test and a Panic Test.

sharedRules.name: Poisonous Spit
sharedRules.description: After resolving the Ropuchons’ attacks, select an enemy unit that is in base contact with them. Roll a D6 for each base in the Ropuchons unit. The opponent must take a Panic Test for each 1 and 2 you scored.

sharedRules.name: Creature
sharedRules.description: This unit cannot pray

sharedRules.name: Spear Storm
sharedRules.description: This unit always attacks also with the second rank.

sharedRules.name: Faithful
sharedRules.description: When praying, this unit gets +1 to LD.

sharedRules.name: Iron Discipline
sharedRules.description: Orders issued to this unit can be re-rolled, and each score of 1 means a free order.

sharedRules.name: Agile
sharedRules.description: This unit can always re-roll one D6 when moving or charging.

sharedRules.name: Battle Inspiration
sharedRules.description: A hero attached to this unit gives +2 additional attacks to the pool.

sharedRules.name: Will to Fight
sharedRules.description: If this unit destroyed an enemy unit, it can regroup up to 10 cm instead of 5 cm.

sharedRules.name: Fierce
sharedRules.description: For each score of 1 in the Wound Test, this unit may roll two additional D6 for wounding. The obtained scores do not generate the new ones.

sharedRules.name: Gold Armour (Save)
sharedRules.description: Each Wound this unit is dealt can be cancelled by exceptional armour. Roll a D6. A score of 2 or less means a cancelled Wound.

sharedRules.name: Immunity
sharedRules.description: When this unit takes a Panic Test, it is failed only on a score of 5 or 6.

sharedRules.name: Tearing
sharedRules.description: When charging, this unit has WS 4.

sharedRules.name: Primal Rampage
sharedRules.description: When charging, Desauros must take a D6 test to see if it goes berserk. A score of 2 or less means that Desauros gains +3 Attacks.

sharedRules.name: Responsive
sharedRules.description: This unit can be issued an order in 40 cm from the General.

sharedRules.name: Sneaky
sharedRules.description: This unit gets +2 attacks for attacking the enemy’s flank or rear.

sharedRules.name: Vigilant
sharedRules.description: The enemy unit does not receive bonuses for attacking this unit’s flank or rear.

sharedRules.name: Enslaved
sharedRules.description: The opponent gains Blood Points for bases from this unit only after destroying the entire unit.

sharedRules.name: Hammer Strike
sharedRules.description: For each score of 1 and 2 in the Wound Test, this unit can roll an additional D6 for wounding. The obtained scores do not generate the new ones.

sharedRules.name: Snake Move
sharedRules.description: This unit can move or charge through enemy or friendly units if its move ends outside the unit that it was moving or charging through.

sharedRules.name: Living Catapult
sharedRules.description: During its activation, Forgon can spit at target enemy unit (but not single model) within 30 cm that is not engaged in combat. Roll a D6. A score of 3 or less means the enemy unit must take a Panic Test for 2 of its bases.

sharedRules.name: Bloodshed
sharedRules.description: This unit may re-roll all failed scores in the Wound Test.

sharedRules.name: Light Shield Defence (Save)
sharedRules.description: For each Wound this unit is dealt, roll a D6 for Light Shield Defence. Each score of 1 means a cancelled Wound.

sharedRules.name: Wild Charge
sharedRules.description: When charging, this unit gets +1 to S.

sharedRules.name: Fury
sharedRules.description: When charging, this unit gets +2 additional attacks to the pool for each full rank of the charged enemy unit or +1 additional attack for each W point of the charged enemy single model. The bonus from Fury can never exceed 10 attacks.

sharedRules.name: Terrible Damage
sharedRules.description: Each score of 1 in the Wound Test deals an additional Wound.

sharedRules.name: Scare
sharedRules.description: The enemy unit that is in base contact with this unit, must take a Panic Test at the end of the cycle for each base lost earlier in the same cycle.

sharedRules.name: Cult
sharedRules.description: The enemy gains 1 Blood Point after destroying two bases instead of one in this unit.

sharedRules.name: The God of Slaughter Blessing
sharedRules.description: When praying, this unit has LD 10.

sharedRules.name: Crushing Blow
sharedRules.description: Each successful score in the Weapon Skill Test made by this unit is considered a Double Hit.

sharedRules.name: Cleaving
sharedRules.description: No saves are permitted against the attacks made by this unit.

sharedRules.name: Throwing stones
sharedRules.description: If a friendly unit within 20 cm of the Giant is charged by an enemy unit, the Giant may immediately throw stones at the charging enemy. The enemy unit must subtract D6+2 attacks from its pool. The Giant can use this ability once per cycle.

sharedRules.name: Keen Senses
sharedRules.description: This unit can turn in any direction, with no limits, before making a move or charge.

sharedRules.name: Brutal Trap
sharedRules.description: This unit doubles the bonus for attacking the enemy’s flank or rear.

sharedRules.name: Curse of the Witch
sharedRules.description: A Cold Blood Test taken by an enemy unit engaged in combat with this unit is always considered failed.

sharedRules.name: Trample
sharedRules.description: For each successful score in the Weapon Skill Test, roll an additional D6 for hitting. Additional successful scores do not generate the new ones.

sharedRules.name: Monster
sharedRules.description: The enemy engaged in combat with this unit fails a Panic Test on a 2+, ignoring any support coming from heroes.

sharedRules.name: Focused Attack
sharedRules.description: When charging, this unit gets +1 to WS.

sharedRules.name: Precise Hit
sharedRules.description: This unit may re-roll all failed scores in the Weapon Skill Test.

sharedRules.name: Fierce Assault
sharedRules.description: When charging, this unit gets additional +2 attacks for each full rank.

sharedRules.name: Magic Runes
sharedRules.description: A successful Prayer Test of this unit means that the unit can use the rules of two different prayers instead of one. Such additional prayer does not decrease the pool of prayers.

sharedRules.name: Ambush
sharedRules.description: This unit can make a free move before the battle. In addition, the enemy unit cannot use charge bonuses and independent bonuses while charging this unit.

sharedRules.name: Wild Speed
sharedRules.description: This unit always rolls an additional D6 when moving or charging, regardless of the situation.

sharedRules.name: Momentum
sharedRules.description: When charging, this unit has an A stat increased by 1.

sharedRules.name: Hunter’s Instinct
sharedRules.description: When attacking single models and units with Creature, this unit does not subtract dice for the difference between Strength and Toughness.

sharedRules.name: Woodiness (Save)
sharedRules.description: Roll a D6 for each Wound this unit is dealt. Each score of 1 means a cancelled Wound.

sharedRules.name: Venom
sharedRules.description: If the enemy unit (but not single model) is dealt a Wound during combat with this unit, the wounded base is removed.

sharedRules.name: Sweeping Slash
sharedRules.description: This unit can re-roll each score of 6 in the Weapon Skill Test.

sharedRules.name: Toxic Spores
sharedRules.description: The enemy unit attacking Trefloq always has -1 to S.

sharedRules.name: Under the spell
sharedRules.description: This unit can only be deployed if there is Beast Master in the army. If the army loses its last Beast Master, roll a D6 before activating Wild Creatures. On a score of 5 or 6, the unit loses an Action Die. A different score means it can be activated normally.

sharedRules.name: Frenzy
sharedRules.description: When charging, this unit doubles its Attacks (A) stat.

sharedRules.name: Roar
sharedRules.description: Once per its turn, Marmydon may roll a D6. On a score of 2 or less, every enemy unit within 20 cm of Marmydon must take a Panic Test for two bases.

sharedRules.name: Thick Hide (Save)
sharedRules.description: Roll a D6 for each Wound this unit is dealt. Each score of 1 means a cancelled Wound.

sharedRules.name: Fall of the Leviathan
sharedRules.description: When Marmydon loses its last W point, every unit touching its base must take a 2D6 test. A score lower than unit’s LD means that unit is dealt D6+2 Wounds with no saves permitted.

sharedRules.name: King of the Wild
sharedRules.description: Each enemy unit within 10 cm of Forest Dragon loses the Horde rule if it has one. Each friendly unit within 10 cm has Fearless.

sharedRules.name: Winged Creature
sharedRules.description: When both armies are deployed, Forest Dragon can be deployed up to 20 cm from its deployment zone.

sharedRules.name: Heavy Armour (Save)
sharedRules.description: Each Wound this unit is dealt may be cancelled by heavy armour. Roll a D6 for each Wound this unit is dealt. Each score of 2 or less means a cancelled Wound.

sharedRules.name: Too late for hope
sharedRules.description: In the army led by Lord of the Abyss, this unit has Unyielding – After a failed charge, this unit can never be turned by the opponent.

sharedRules.name: Fear
sharedRules.description: After a successful charge with this unit, the enemy unit (but not single model) must take a Panic Test for 1 base. If this unit is a Horde, the enemy must take a Panic Test for 2 bases instead.

sharedRules.name: Corpse Horde
sharedRules.description: Only Lord Necromancer can attach to this unit. After each lost combat, this unit must roll a D6. The score is the number of additional Wounds it is dealt. In the army led by Lord Necromancer, this unit can add a rank of Marauders to the Horde that allowed to deploy them (such a Horde consists of 20 bases).

sharedRules.name: Ancient Steel
sharedRules.description: If this unit rolled at least three 1s during the Weapon Skill Test, it gets +1 to S until the end of the cycle.

sharedRules.name: Baaaaaa!!!
sharedRules.description: When praying, this unit has LD 9.

sharedRules.name: Fanatical Loyalty
sharedRules.description: In the army led by Lord of Sheol-morg, as long as this unit is a Horde, it may sacrifice one base to re-roll the failed order issued to them by the General.

sharedRules.name: Amok
sharedRules.description: After this unit’s attacks, roll a D6 for each Wound inflicted upon the enemy. Each score of 1 or 2 means the enemy is dealt an additional Wound.

sharedRules.name: Spasms
sharedRules.description: When attacking, this unit gets additional D6+1 attacks. If this unit is a Horde, the number of additional attacks is D6+4.

sharedRules.name: Born in the Abyss
sharedRules.description: When attacking Hydra, the enemy cannot use charge bonuses.

sharedRules.name: Dark Vomit
sharedRules.description: After a successful charge with Hydra, and after positioning the units, choose target enemy unit within 10 cm of Hydra. Roll 5D6 – each score of 2 or less means the chosen enemy unit is dealt 1 Wound.

sharedRules.name: Brutality
sharedRules.description: After a successful charge and Wound Test made with this unit, the enemy unit (but not single model) is dealt additional 1 Wound for each full rank of this unit.

sharedRules.name: Brawl
sharedRules.description: During the enemy unit’s Weapon Skill Test, before any re-rolls, seize all dice showing a score of 6. Perform attacks with the seized dice immediately (without bonuses) before the enemy makes further rolls. The seized dice are not returned.

sharedRules.name: Envy
sharedRules.description: When performing a Wound Test against an enemy unit whose cost per base is larger than the Knuroses’, the Knuroses gain +3 dice to the Wound Test.

sharedRules.name: Reckless
sharedRules.description: This unit can never be issued orders. Instead, during the Heroes actions, you may choose a friendly unit of Knuroses that is not engaged in combat and has enemy unit within 15 cm. Roll a D6. A score of 2 or less means that the Knuroses may immediately charge at the indicated enemy unit. This rule can be used only once per cycle and only by one unit of Knuroses in the army.

sharedRules.name: Rage
sharedRules.description: During combat result, if the enemy unit or units lost more bases in total than the unit with Rage they are engaged in combat with, if the combat continues in the subsequent cycle, the unit with Rage is treated as if charging.

sharedRules.name: Master Ambush
sharedRules.description: The enemy unit cannot use charge bonuses and independent bonuses while charging this unit. If this unit consists of 8 bases or less, when both armies are deployed and the opponent finishes making any free moves he is allowed to make before the battle, you may deploy this unit anywhere on the battlefield, but not closer than 20 cm from the enemy. If this unit consists of more than 8 bases, it must be deployed in a standard way, but can make a free move before the battle.

sharedRules.name: Acid Spit
sharedRules.description: When the enemy unit declares a charge against Larva of Nalharap, roll a D6 for the acid spit. A score of 3 or less means that the enemy unit is hit by the acid and loses 2 Wounds with no saves permitted. In addition, the charge is automatically failed and the enemy must follow the rules of a failed charge.

sharedRules.name: Slowness
sharedRules.description: Due to its sluggishness and bulk, Larva can never roll more than one D6 when rolling for the charge range.

sharedRules.name: Curse of Blood
sharedRules.description: If the enemy unit (but not single model) has suffered any losses as a result of combat with the Prophet, roll a D6 for each base the enemy unit lost. Each score of 4 or less means that other target enemy unit within 40 cm of the Prophet is dealt 1 Wound with no saves permitted.

sharedRules.name: Dark Aura
sharedRules.description: Once per battle, in any cycle, after the Initiative Test, regardless of the number of friendly Prophets, you may decide that your army becomes shrouded in Dark Aura. The opponent’s army cannot use magic items, spells and prayers until the end of the cycle.

sharedRules.name: Marauders
sharedRules.description: Each unit you have deployed on the battlefield, consisting of the maximum number of bases (16 bases), allows you to place a free additional unit called Marauders. This unit always has 4 bases, is the same type as the 16 bases that allowed it to be deployed, and is deployed without adding to the army cost. Such a unit does not count to the limit of units that can be deployed in the army, and is not treated as a unit in the required minimum. The Marauders unit cannot be expanded or combined with other Marauders. The enemy gains Blood Points as normal for defeating Marauders.

sharedRules.name: Agile Flight
sharedRules.description: This unit can move or charge over any obstacles, including terrain or other units. The unit may turn after completing its movement instead of before moving. The unit can get into base contact with an enemy hero only after completing its movement and any turning. It cannot roll a D6 for the hero’s death; an enemy hero dies only if it cannot attach to a friendly unit or use its special rules.

sharedRules.name: Predator
sharedRules.description: When this unit is attacking an enemy’s flank, its WS and S are increased by 1, and if attacking an enemy’s rear, its WS and S are increased by 2.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The unit that will move or charge has the right to double the score on one of the dice.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
If the unit makes a successful charge against an enemy unit (but not single model), roll a D6. Compare the results:
1-2 The charged enemy unit must immediately take a Panic Test for its 3 bases.
3-4 The charged enemy unit must immediately take a Panic Test for its 2 bases.
5-6 The charged enemy unit must immediately take a Panic Test for its 1 base.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The unit can select an enemy unit within 20 cm. During the enemy’s Weapon Skill Test, the enemy must re-roll all successful scores.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The unit may re-roll the failed scores in the Weapon Skill Test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The unit may re-roll the failed scores in the Wound Test during a combat in which it was already engaged.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All Panic Tests taken by this unit are treated as successful.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the unit makes a successful charge, it gets a bonus of +3 attacks to the pool.
